record.name: Eisadern
record.prompt: Original premium painterly dark-fantasy ORAFOLD illustration, landscape 4:3 native 1448 by 1086. Single complete artwork, no text, numerals, logo, card frame, UI or border. Tactile polished brushwork, clear coherent focal anatomy, realistic silver and glass, rich deep shadows, restrained spatial folds. Stillwacht palette ice-blue, silver, midnight slate, clear crystal. Focal face/action central upper 80 percent and safe diagonal lower-right crop. New minor motifs VORSCHLAG only; no world origin, new named leader, Eira reveal, protected references. A conscious winter vine spreads across the underside of a broken stone bridge like a living network of luminous ice veins. Thick translucent root cords visibly fuse into the masonry and keep loose blocks suspended.
